notes.title: Discolored - Episode 2 official announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are well! [b]Discolored - Episode 2[/b] is officially announced! It took a bit longer to get everything ready (typical of game development) but finally I can start showing off what to expect in Episode 2!


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859720/Discolored__Episode_2/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/22be0aa44bcd92381031d98cc84b5347ebaffa76.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859720/Discolored__Episode_2/]View the Steam page for Episode 2![/url]

[h3]And now for a few teasers of what to expect from Episode 2![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/9485df5a3486ffa2e231f2b41d6129ca7d05fd5c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a36a7a01dd8de92d00d745516f97ccd8d2af477c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/fb69ed2162f92a3654384886bb00130a24c5f0cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/522a4ff5694d778b9c658a94583d3658c19b4f3f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/a76cf820880f5030b9b8ac43b317e2c5887ed766.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/11b3909625795b8e63e1972c0d1e177e210f6545.gif[/img]
Check out the game's Steam page (link above) where you can view the trailer and screenshots and if you like what you see it would really help if you could wishlist the game (please). :) Steam keeps track of how quickly and how many wishlists a game gets and if the numbers are high enough it will show the game to more people that browse Steam. In turn hopefully that will lead to the game doing well and I can continue to expand the world of Discolored.

This game will build out the story more and you will run into a couple of characters that can help or harm you in your quest to restore the missing colors. It will play mostly the same as Episode 1 with reality-bending puzzles, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a striking color palette. But there will also be more intense moments where you have to think on your feet because in this episode the evil organization that has stolen all the colors are trying to stop you from bringing them back.

[h3]Join the Newsletter or Discord[/h3]
Want to play the demo? If you'd like to take part in a beta test of the demo [url=https://www.jasongodbey.com/newsletter/]join the mailing list[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZNDxF7puPS]Discord[/url] and I'll be sending out news later with instructions on how you can sign up to play the demo and give feedback. So sign up and stay tuned!
[url=https://www.jasongodbey.com/newsletter/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/3e2206ff9c63486fcbaf27e22f4f27ed4572609d.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZNDxF7puPS][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/1e16266dc9fb2bf7ead726fe3252a8c2b4079cee.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Release date?[/h3]
Right now I can't give a firm release date on when Episode 2 will be completed. I want to make this game much longer than the first episode. If I had to give a timeframe it might be another year and a half before Episode 2 is complete. But it's game dev, so it could be even be longer. But I'm really excited about the ideas I have for this one so I won't be giving up on it and I'll do everything I can to make it best game it can possibly be!

[h3]Trading Cards for Discolored![/h3]
Trading cards are also now available for Discolored! You might have already noticed some in your Steam inventory. Enjoy!


Thank you,
Jason

[i]
P.S. I'd love to hear what you think based on what you see on the Steam page. Feel free to reply to this thread to share your thoughts![/i]

notes.title: Fixes to occasional lag
notes.notes: This update fixes the lag that sometimes occurred when picking up items. It still might show up in a couple of areas, but for the most part should be a lot better than it was.

notes.title: Improvements for speedrunners
notes.notes:
When the Speedrun Skips option is checked in the Settings menu the game will skip auto-saving when picking up items in the game. This is to avoid any lag that might occur during an auto-save when picking up items. The game will still auto-save at the beginning of a level with this option checked. 

Saving the game manually still works as it previously did.

notes.title: Point-and-Click mode, Hints, Highlights, and support for more resolutions
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope you are all doing well. A quality of life update has just been uploaded. It includes the following:

[h2]Point and click mode[/h2]
A new Point and Click mode is available that allows you to navigate in the classic first-person adventure style. You still have the option to navigate in the default style, Free Roam, using WASD keys to move around if you prefer. These movement methods can be changed at anytime in the game in the Settings menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/f9fa046bd15b056bd1ba606bfac6c7fe70ffdc45.png[/img]

[h2]No more Letterbox[/h2]
For those that have monitors at aspect ratios other than 16:9, the letterbox has been removed so you can enjoy the game without the black bars. Most ultra widescreen monitors should benefit from this as well. :)

[h2]Object Highlights[/h2]
A Highlight mode has been added that highlights objects you can interact with as you hover over them. There is an option to disable this in the Settings menu if desired. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/65ff2b25247b5b6bec1c6de4431b738b8a694a31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/364754fc66f201a444c01640ec48063ed1107775.png[/img]

[h2]Hints[/h2]
There are also more detailed hints that can be accessed through the Pause menu. A different hint will show depending on where you are in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33899246/7a30ad944b939961fd61c0d2c33850423601862c.png[/img]

Hope you enjoy and please let me know if you run into any issues!

Thanks,
Jason

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just a quick update to let you know the game has now been patched fixing most of the bugs. 

Some people had an issue with their cursor getting stuck while in the suitcase view, this was addressed a day or so after the game's launch. If you are running into this please make sure you have the latest version and there is no update pending for the game.

There was also an issue with things looking like they were stuttering while moving when running on a high end PC. Note that this wasn't due to low framerate, but rather something out of sync with the way things were setup in the Unity game engine. This has just recently been addressed and should be good to go.

If you run into anything else please let me know.

Thanks!
Jason

notes.title: Motion sickness tip
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

If you play the game and start to feel motion sick please try going into the Settings menu and adjust the Field of View to a larger value and see if that helps. Currently it goes up to 90.

Hope that helps,
Jason

notes.title: Introducing Discolored
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33899246/3e1fcc93ba84075fa42af1faf8b3c5263e8abbc4.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, I'm excited to announce Discolored - an upcoming puzzle-adventure game I've been working on for the past year. Some of you may know I made another game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/566190/The_Search/]The Search [/url]. 

As listed on the Steam page I plan to release Discolored sometime in the 2nd quarter of 2019. If you're wondering if Discolored is a sequel to The Search, it is not, but there are some similarities. Discolored will still feature beautiful atmospheric scenery and a similar "feel" that The Search had. The style for Discolored is very minimal, which is inspired by the painters John Register and  Edward Hopper. 

Discolored's gameplay will be using FPS controls with real-time 3D graphics, similar to modern adventure games like The Witness and Obduction, not a point-and-click with pre-rendered graphics as The Search was. The puzzles actually have more variety in Discolored compared with The Search! The total gameplay time will probably clock in at around an hour or so. 

I will post as much as possible here on how the game's progressing. Alternatively, you can head on over to the [url=http://www.jasongodbey.com/discolored]game's website [/url] to sign up for the newsletter to stay up to date and get exclusive insights. 

If you have any questions please drop me a line in the comments section below or anywhere else you can find me on the web.

Like with The Search, Discolored is being developed on my own and in my spare time. I love making these games and I thank you for your support!
